governance_center: read the current qualified flagship catalog
rank qualified candidates by estimated task cost
assign the selected models to expert roles
bind the plan to the task SHA-256
write the immutable governance_model_plan into the child ticket
expert_center: validate the governance plan schema, task hash and plan hash
resolve one compatible exact provider endpoint for each named model
build and validate the finite NetworkX DAG
execute the exact models named by governance
publish model, provider, token, cost and audit evidence

use_when: the task requires multidisciplinary judgment rather than only deterministic calculation
evidence, assumptions, trade-offs, strategy, policy, business, risk, or red-team analysis must be synthesized
the user explicitly requests the GitHub expert team
API or compute results require independent interpretation and adjudication
do_not_use_when: a fixed API connector can directly return the requested public data
a deterministic compute operation can fully answer the question
the user requests an immediate factual lookup without expert synthesis
the ticket would contain secrets, private personal data, or unverified artifact identifiers without the underlying body

quality_policy.primary_rule: qualified flagship models first, then estimated task cost from low to high
quality_policy.company_rule: all selected and recovery models must come from distinct model companies
quality_policy.provider_rule: provider choice is not model choice; the expert runtime may only resolve the cheapest compatible exact endpoint for a governance-selected model
quality_policy.failure_rule: missing, altered, stale, incompatible or incomplete plans fail closed without local reselection

outputs: one final synthesis report or a structured failure
call ledger with actual models, providers, tokens, cost and errors
governance model-plan digest and execution diagnosis
report SHA-256 and public comment manifest
artifact manifest and authoritative PASS, DEGRADED or FAIL status
completion_rule: Only EXECUTION_COMPLETED with the complete final synthesis and verified delivery evidence is a normal PASS. queued, in_progress, accepted, workflow success, or artifact metadata alone are not completion.
restrictions: GPTs must not choose a concrete model ID or provider
the expert center must not choose or replace models
experts cannot browse, call tools, plugins, APIs or download artifacts
no unlimited retries, replacements or agent loops
no secret or private data in public issues
no self-answer by Web GPT before the GitHub report when delegation is explicit

upstream_guidance.api_first: Use the API center first when current structured public data is required.
upstream_guidance.compute_first: Use the compute center first when quantitative simulation or deterministic analysis is required.
upstream_guidance.evidence_transfer: GPTs must retrieve and verify complete upstream bodies and SHA values before creating the expert ticket.
